about.ourGoalIsToReduceTheNeedFor: Our goal is to reduce the need for multiple tools and help you get everything in one convenient app. Muslim Sync brings together all the essential Islamic tools you need for your daily spiritual journey.
about.weBelieveInProvidingACleanDistractionFre: We believe in providing a clean, distraction-free experience. Muslim Sync is completely ad-free, allowing you to focus on what matters most - your connection with Allah.
about.everyoneIsWelcomeToGiveFeedbackAboutWhat: Everyone is welcome to give feedback about what they want to be added. We value your input and suggestions to make Muslim Sync better for the entire Muslim community.
about.inshaallahWeWillContinueToAddFeaturesBas: InshaAllah, we will continue to add features based on your needs.

helpSupport.howDoIChangePrayerTimesCalculationMethod: How do I change prayer times calculation method?
helpSupport.goToSettingsPrayerTimeCalculationAndSele: Go to Settings > Prayer Time Calculation and select your preferred method. The app supports 15 different calculation methods including ISNA, MWL, and others.
helpSupport.canIUseTheAppOffline: Can I use the app offline?
helpSupport.yesYouCanDownloadTheQuranTranslationsAnd: Yes! You can download the Quran, translations, and audio recitations for offline use. Go to the Quran screen, tap the menu icon, and use the download options.
helpSupport.howDoIFindNearbyMosques: How do I find nearby mosques?
helpSupport.openTheMosquesTabAndAllowLocationAccess: Open the Mosques tab and allow location access. The app will show all mosques in your city, sorted by distance with the closest ones first.
helpSupport.yesMuslimSyncIs100AdFreeWe: Yes! Muslim Sync is 100% ad-free. We believe in providing a clean, distraction-free experience for all users.
helpSupport.weWelcomeAllFeedbackSendUsAnEmail: We welcome all feedback! Send us an email at contact@muslimsync.com with your suggestions. InshaAllah, we will continue to add features based on your needs.
helpSupport.needAssistanceWeReHereToHelpReach: Need assistance? We're here to help! Reach out to us through email and we'll get back to you as soon as possible.
helpSupport.haveAQuestionSuggestionOrNeedHelpSend: Have a question, suggestion, or need help? Send us an email and we'll respond promptly.
